subject.title: fix(skills): refuse owner-qualified ClawHub force install over a different owner

question: Should OpenClaw fail closed for owner-qualified forced installs over a differently owner-tracked ClawHub skill while preserving the ownerless tracked-skill fallback?
rationale: The patch fixes a real clobber path, but it narrows an existing `--force` behavior and leaves ownerless tracked state overwriteable for compatibility, which is maintainer product intent rather than a purely mechanical code decision.

options.title: Accept Documented Owner Guard
options.body: Land this PR as-is, treating known cross-owner forced installs as unsafe while keeping ownerless tracked skills overwriteable for compatibility.

options.title: Make Ownerless Strict Too
options.body: Require the same refusal for owner-qualified forced installs over ownerless tracked skills, then update tests and docs for the stricter upgrade behavior.

options.title: Design Explicit Replacement UX
options.body: Pause this PR if `--force` must stay an unconditional replacement escape hatch until a dedicated replace-owner or uninstall-then-install flow exists.

recommendation.title: Accept Documented Owner Guard
recommendation.body: Land this PR as-is, treating known cross-owner forced installs as unsafe while keeping ownerless tracked skills overwriteable for compatibility.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent ClawHub lifecycle hardening makes this the best available routing owner for the compatibility choice.
